shellCommands.command:
node server.mjs &
sleep 1
# add two books
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n' -X POST -d 'title=Dune&author=Frank+Herbert&notes=Sandworms+%3C3%0ARead+slowly.' http://localhost:3000/add
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST -d 'title=Piranesi&author=Susanna+Clarke' http://localhost:3000/add
# home page
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'h2|href="/book'

ID=6f47f9f7-5e7f-48e6-89b8-9e145cd4df34
# detail page (the shareable link)
curl -s http://localhost:3000/book/$ID | grep -E 'h1|author|notes|Currently'
# mark finished
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'finish: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n' -X POST http://localhost:3000/book/$ID/finish
# home now shows it under Finished
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | sed -n '/Finished</,/Add a book/p' | grep -E 'href|muted'
# 404 + bad input
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'unknown book: %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/book/nope
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'missing fields: %{http_code}\n' -X POST -d 'title=&author=' http://localhost:3000/add

# restart the server and confirm the books survive
kill %1 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5
node server.mjs & sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep 'href="/book'
kill %1
cat /workspace/books.json

pkill -f 'node server.mjs'; sleep 0.5
node server.mjs & sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | sed -n '/Currently reading/,/Add a book/p' | grep -E 'h2|href'
pkill -f 'node server.mjs'

pgrep -f 'node server.mjs' || echo 'no server running'
node server.mjs > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E '<h2|href="/book'
pkill -f 'node server.mjs' || true
echo done
pgrep -f 'node server.mjs' && pkill -f 'node server.mjs'; pgrep -f 'node server.mjs' || echo 'clean'; rm -f /workspace/books.json
pgrep -ax node; fuser -k 3000/tcp 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; pgrep -ax node; rm -f /workspace/books.json; echo cleaned
